name: Raiding Parties
text: Every player loses 12 credits.

name: War Footing
text: Every military base fills with corp troops to its cap now. Sway 3 toward Discord.

name: Purge the Unaligned
text: Every player loses 2 ambassadors (from their supply, else ones on the board). 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city) in each country. Remove 1 Unity from the Unity track.

name: Armored Columns
text: In each country, 3 troops land on factories (else cities).

name: Arms Race
text: Ongoing: each round, every military base makes 1 extra corp troop, even past its cap (at most 1 extra a base in each production, whatever makes it); sway 1 toward Discord.

name: Declaration of War
text: In each country, 3 troops land on factories (else cities); sway 3 toward Discord. Ongoing: each round, the front with the most corp troops fights twice.

name: Disinformation
text: Sway 5 toward Discord. Every player loses 2 ambassadors.

name: Recruitment Drive
text: Ongoing: every round, each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 3 lowest-numbered clean cities.

name: Infiltration Drive
text: Each board: create 3 adversary ambassadors on the lowest-numbered clean city. Corrupt cities (1 fewer). Every player loses an ambassador. Sway 3 toward Discord.

name: Data Heist
text: Every player loses 5 tokens from their cards and gets 3 less insight next round.

name: Botnet Swarm
text: Each board: create 3 adversary ambassadors on each of the 2 lowest-numbered botnet hexes.

name: Station Coup
text: Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered research stations. Then in each country, players choose a research station that is not the adversary's; it flips to the adversary, but a player's holds unless 2 adversary ambassadors and no player ambassador are on it (those 2 return to the supply as it flips). If it holds, 1 adversary ambassador lands on it (or cancels a player ambassador there).

name: Market Crash
text: Every player gets 9 fewer credits of income next round and loses all their chips.

name: Shadow Factories
text: The adversary builds a factory in the country with the most free industrial zones (tie: the first country), on a free zone next to an adversary ambassador, else the lowest-numbered one (none: 2 of its ambassadors land on a factory). Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered factories.

name: Capital Flight
text: Every player's income falls by 6 credits for the rest of the game.

name: Rolling Blackouts
text: Every player loses 2 energy. Next round, cities make no energy and research stations produce nothing.

name: Grid Capture
text: Every player loses 2 energy. Ongoing: every round, every player loses 1 energy.

name: False Flag
text: Deal 1 extra tier-2 threat in each country, any tag. Sway 2 toward Discord.

name: Grand Offensive
text: The adversary builds now, then Corrupt cities; 1 troop lands on a factory (else a city) in each country; sway 3 toward Discord.

name: Propaganda Network
text: Ongoing: every round, sway 3 toward Discord, remove 2 Unity from the Unity track. Each board: create 2 adversary ambassadors on the lowest-numbered corrupted city.
